q2_gaps: A comitative/accompaniment PP naming an INANIMATE co-participant that undergoes the same action ("burns wintergloss alongside mire-essence"): CoAgent is animate-only and Instrument is the means, and no role records a second thing burned, so the co-burning reading survives only as the opaque preposition-named oblique.
notes: Alongside is the licensed surface-preposition oblique (the word actually used, no synonym head), the inanimate transitive subject correctly stays Agent, the bare mass objects stay kind constants, and the bare simple present correctly takes no status atom. (Inheritance wintergloss gloss) follows the solid-compound "always emit the genus" rule, but the IS-A it asserts is unverifiable for a coined substance and may be the suppressed-genus case instead.
